title: Anna asks her bank to pay Clara 25.00 EUR
explanation: The app sends the payment by phone number (alias) plus the payee name the user entered or picked from contacts; the bank needs the name for the encrypted part. The transport (POST /i1/messages) is our choice; the message content follows D1-1. Sim-User-DEAN is a placeholder for the app's authentication: it tells the bank who is logged in (INTERPRETATION A12).
